title: Run your side of a 1:1 meeting (B1)
summary: Trong cuộc 1:1 với quản lý: báo tiến độ ngắn, nêu một vướng mắc và xin hướng dẫn, rồi chốt hành động tiếp theo.
learningObjectives: Báo tiến độ ngắn gọn bằng ba ý
Nêu vướng mắc và điều bạn cần từ quản lý
Chốt hành động và thời hạn trước khi kết thúc

sections.title: 1:1 agenda
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: weekly 1:1 between a developer and a manager. Manager: What would you like to talk about today? Notes: start with progress, then one challenge, then ask for guidance, and finish with who does what by when.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Mức độ công việc đã hoàn thành so với kế hoạch.
vocabulary.example: I made good progress on the import tool.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu: PROG-ress.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều khó đang làm chậm công việc của bạn.
vocabulary.example: My main challenge is the test environment.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói a challenge, không nói a challenging khi là danh từ.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Việc quan trọng nhất cần làm trước.
vocabulary.example: Which task is the top priority this week?
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: pri-OR-i-ty.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Lời khuyên giúp bạn quyết định hướng đi.
vocabulary.example: I would like some guidance on this decision.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Guidance không đếm được: some guidance.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Làm việc tiếp theo sau cuộc họp.
vocabulary.example: I will follow up by email tomorrow.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Động từ viết follow up, danh từ viết follow-up.

expressions.example: Since our last 1:1, I have finished the import tool and started the tests.

expressions.phrase: My main challenge right now is ___.
expressions.example: My main challenge right now is the unstable test environment.
alternatives: One thing slowing me down is ___.

expressions.phrase: I would like some guidance on ___.
expressions.example: I would like some guidance on whether to fix it now or after the release.
alternatives: What would you do in my position?

expressions.phrase: So the next step is ___, and I will ___ by ___.
expressions.meaning: Chốt hành động và thời hạn.
expressions.example: So the next step is a decision on the environment, and I will send a plan by Thursday.

exercises.question: Which sentence starts a progress update well?
options: Since our last 1:1, I have finished the import tool.
I was busy with many things.
correctAnswer: Since our last 1:1, I have finished the import tool.
exercises.explanation: Mở đầu bằng việc đã hoàn thành cụ thể.

exercises.question: Which sentence asks for guidance?
options: What would you do in my position?
I do not need any help.
correctAnswer: What would you do in my position?
exercises.explanation: Câu hỏi mở xin ý kiến quản lý.

exercises.question: Điền từ: I will follow ___ by email tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: Follow up là cụm động từ.

exercises.question: Sắp xếp một cuộc 1:1.
exercises.explanation: Tiến độ, vướng mắc, xin hướng dẫn, hành động.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu: I made good ___ on the import tool.
Điền từ còn thiếu: My main ___ is the test environment.

performanceTask.title: Run your side of a 1:1
performanceTask.scenario: Bạn họp 1:1 hằng tuần với quản lý; quản lý hỏi bạn muốn bàn điều gì.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Nói bằng tiếng Anh trong khoảng một phút: báo tiến độ, nêu một vướng mắc, xin hướng dẫn và chốt hành động tiếp theo. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak in English for about one minute: give a progress update, name one challenge, ask for guidance and confirm the next step with a date.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Thanks for meeting with me. Since our last 1:1, I have finished the import tool and started the tests. Progress is good, and I expect to demo it next week. My main challenge right now is the unstable test environment, because it fails about one run in five and slows every review. I would like some guidance on whether to fix it now or after the release. What would you do in my position? Also, I think the top priority this week should be the customer report, so I plan to pause the cleanup work. So the next step is a decision on the environment, and I will send a short plan by Thursday. Does that sound right to you, or should I change anything?
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Speak again in English. Keep the four parts and make the challenge more specific.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Run a 1:1 for a different situation, such as a late project with unclear requirements.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Run another 1:1 without looking at old notes.

baseline.title: Weekly 1:1 about a tool

rubric.label: Four parts
rubric.description: Progress, challenge, guidance and next step.

anchors.met: The manager hears all four parts in order.
anchors.notMet: A part is missing, such as no next step.

rubric.label: Specific challenge
rubric.description: The challenge has detail and impact.

anchors.met: Names the problem and how it affects the work.
anchors.notMet: Says "things are hard" with no detail.

rubric.label: Owns the next step
rubric.description: You propose an action and a date.

anchors.met: Says "I will ... by ..." with a date.
anchors.notMet: Waits for the manager to decide everything.

audio.text: Since our last 1:1, I have finished the import tool.
My main challenge right now is the unstable test environment.

pretest.question: What is the problem?
options: A tight budget for the team

audio.text: I would like some guidance on whether to fix it now or later.
I will send a short plan by Thursday.
Thanks for meeting with me. I have a short update.

training.question: What is the speaker about to do?
training.feedback: Short update là cập nhật ngắn.

audio.text: The tests fail about one run in five.

training.question: How often do the tests fail?
training.feedback: One in five là một trên năm.

audio.text: This slows every review and delays the demo.

training.question: What is the effect?
training.feedback: Slows và delays nêu tác động.

audio.text: What would you do in my position?

training.question: What is the speaker asking?
options: For a salary for the team
training.feedback: In my position là ở vị trí của tôi.

audio.text: I think the top priority this week should be the customer report.

training.question: What does the speaker prioritize?
options: A tool upgrade for the team
training.feedback: Top priority là ưu tiên cao nhất.

audio.text: To confirm, I will update the plan and share it tomorrow.

training.question: What is confirmed?
options: A salary change for the team

audio.text: Over the past week, I fixed two bugs and wrote a design note.
One thing slowing me down is a missing access request.

posttest.question: What is the blocker?
options: A broken chair for the team

audio.text: I would like some guidance on how to prioritize these two tasks.

posttest.question: What advice is needed?
options: Which phone to buy for the team

audio.text: So the next step is a quick call, and I will book it today.

posttest.question: What will the speaker do today?
options: Write a report for the team

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn âm đầu của progress và challenge để phần báo cáo nghe rõ.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Nhấn sai làm progress nghe giống động từ.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Đọc rõ guidance và position, nhấn âm thứ hai của position.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Nuốt âm làm câu hỏi xin hướng dẫn khó nghe.
